map.name: Fort Kholm
map.setting: a frozen fort on a mountain pass
map.trouble: The Necromancer Ulvana has woken the dead of the Glacier Crypts above Wyrmtooth Pass; her Undead come down on the fort every night and the pass is shut.

guard_bark.specifics: Brunn keeps the north gate of Fort Kholm, shut by Marshal Odric while Ulvana's Undead hold the pass.

first.speaker: Brunn
first.text: This is the north gate, Marshal Odric's post. The pass beyond is closed to all.

again.speaker: Brunn
again.text: Oh, one more thing. Keep off the wall walk. It's solid ice up there.

later.speaker: Brunn
later.text: The gate is open! Up the pass with you, and hurry! The Marshal is counting on you!

bounty_offer.specifics: Fennick, a fussy mapmaker, pays a bounty to be rid of the Imps nesting in the fort's chimney flues.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text: Ah. Good day. I take it you have read my notice? Imps! The wretched creatures have got into everything. They spill my ink and gnaw my maps, and the noise! I cannot work at all! I will pay a proper bounty to whoever rids Fort Kholm of them. Well? Will you do it?

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: Still Imps! I hear them scratching in the chimney flues every night. Please hurry!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: Gone? Truly gone? Oh, what a relief! At last I can return to my maps. Here is your bounty, 100 gold pieces, and well earned.

journal.text: Rid Fort Kholm of the Imps and collect Fennick's bounty.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Gorrin, the signal keeper, wants back the spyglass the Urchins of the Snow Caves stole from his tower.

offer.speaker: Gorrin
offer.text:
Bother and blast! Robbed again?! Those nefarious little Urchins crept into the signal tower in the night and pilfered my spyglass! Without it I cannot keep watch on the pass. Ulvana's Undead could march right up to the gate and I would be none the wiser!

The thieves keep a den in the Snow Caves, west of the Ice Bridge. If you could get my spyglass back, the whole fort would sleep easier. Will you go after it?

refusal.speaker: Gorrin
refusal.text: Then I shall keep the watch with these poor old eyes. Hmph.

reminder.speaker: Gorrin
reminder.text: Any sign of my spyglass? I've been squinting at that pass all day!

completion.speaker: Gorrin
completion.text:
My spyglass! Splendid! Now I can resume my vigil.

Here, take this spell book. A traveling Wizard left it with me years ago to pay for his supper. I never could make sense of a word in it.

journal.text: Recover Gorrin's spyglass from the Urchins in the Snow Caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Gorrin's spyglass from the Urchins in the Snow Caves.

rumour.specifics: Three folk of Fort Kholm: Hagen warns of the pass, old Mag frets over the stores, Lissa flirts.

rumour1.speaker: Hagen
rumour1.text: Stay away from the high pass after dark! The dead walk up there!

rumour2.speaker: Mag
rumour2.text: No sledges... no bread... and the dead at the gate.

rumour3.speaker: Lissa
rumour3.text: Ooh, a new face in the fort! Come warm yourself by my fire some night, when you're done with all that fighting.

shop_greeting.specifics: Olva of the Snowbound Inn, Thudd of Thudd's Armory, Yeva who sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Olva
inn.text: Welcome to the Snowbound Inn. Not a single guest since the pass was closed. I'm thinking of packing up and going down the mountain myself.

arms.speaker: Thudd
arms.text: Welcome to Thudd's Armory! Best steel on the mountain! And if it won't kill the Undead, you can always use it to chip the ice off your beard!

magic.speaker: Yeva
magic.text: Ah, a customer! I do hope your purse is heavy, Wanderer. Everything costs a little more this far up the mountain.

two_givers.specifics: Wendric the Priest gives the key to the chapel vault the Undead have desecrated; Lucky Skiv bets the player won't come back up.

offer_a.speaker: Wendric
offer_a.text:
Good day. I trust you are here regarding the chapel vault. The Undead broke into the vault beneath this chapel and desecrated the tombs of the fort's honored dead. I have barred the door, but I lack the strength to purge the abominable things myself.

Here, take this iron key, it opens the vault door behind the altar. Will you go down and cleanse the vault?

offer_b.speaker: Lucky Skiv
offer_b.text: Going down into Wendric's vault, are you? Ha! I'll wager you 100 gold you don't come back up. Do we have a bet?

outcome_a.speaker: Wendric
outcome_a.text: The vault is quiet once more! Our honored dead may rest in peace. Take this shield, with the blessing of the chapel. And go see Marshal Odric, he will want to hear of this.

outcome_b.speaker: Lucky Skiv
outcome_b.text: You?! Back from the vault, and not a scratch?! Well, I never welsh on a wager. Here's your 100 gold. Don't tell the others.

journal_a.text: Cleanse the chapel vault of the Undead for Wendric.

journal_b.text: Come back alive from the chapel vault and collect on Skiv's bet.

rescue.specifics: Gelbrand the provisioner's sledge crew, robbed by the Trolls, are locked in the old salt store; he hands over the key.

plea.speaker: Gelbrand
plea.text:
Thieving, lumbering brutes! The Trolls fell upon my supply sledges and plundered every barrel!

My sledge crew escaped with their lives and barricaded themselves in behind a stout door. But now the abominable creatures have them besieged, and the cold will finish what the Trolls began. I fear for them.

I'll make you a bargain, stranger. Liberate my men and bring them home, and you will not find me ungrateful. Here is the key to their door. Go swiftly!

reminder.speaker: Gelbrand
reminder.text: My men are holed up in the old salt store under the north wall. Please, hurry!

found.speaker: Sledge crew
found.text: The key! You've got the key! Get us out of here, quick!

following.speaker: Sledge crew
following.text: Lead the way. We'll stay right behind you.

completion.speaker: Gelbrand
completion.text: My sledge crew, home safe! You have done a noble deed for Fort Kholm this day. Please, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Free Gelbrand's sledge crew from the Trolls.

main_opening.specifics: Hagen points the player to Marshal Odric on the wall; Odric, Faldrin's old friend, gives him a sword and sends him up to the Glacier Crypts after Ulvana.

herald.speaker: Hagen
herald.text: Marshal Odric's been pacing the wall all morning, waiting on somebody from the lowlands. That'd be you, I expect.

opening.speaker: Marshal Odric
opening.text:
So, you have arrived at last, lad! Faldrin's letter came up the pass ahead of you. He speaks well of you.

Hear me. The Necromancer Ulvana -- curse her name -- has woken the dead of the Glacier Crypts, high above the fort. Every night her Undead come down Wyrmtooth Pass and every night we drive them back. My men grow cold and weary.

Take this sword, it served me well in younger days. Climb to the Crypts and put an end to Ulvana, or Fort Kholm will not see the spring!

reminder.speaker: Marshal Odric
reminder.text: The Crypts, lad! Go! My men cannot hold the wall forever!

journal.text: Climb to the Glacier Crypts and destroy the Necromancer Ulvana.
